build_awq_marlin_config: build an AWQMarlinConfig instance from a quantization config dictionary with bits, group_size, and zero_point
convert_awq_weights_to_standard_format: convert AWQ packed weight and zero-point tensors to standard GPTQ-like format for Marlin kernels
create_awq_marlin_linear_method: create an AWQMarlinLinearMethod to run 4-bit quantized linear layers using the Marlin kernel
test_awq_marlin_compatibility: test whether an AWQ-quantized model is compatible with the AWQMarlin runtime kernel
apply_awq_marlin_moe_forward: apply AWQMarlinMoEMethod to perform fused MoE inference with 4-bit quantized expert weights
